subject: Sales → CS: LumenHealth production onboarding — timeline, owners, and prerequisites
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ellie Morgan <ellie.morgan@lumenhealth.com>, Trevor Shaw <trevor.shaw@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Jul 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Sales → CS: LumenHealth production onboarding — timeline, owners, and prerequisites

Team — handing over LumenHealth to CS for implementation. Quick context and asks below so we can kick off Sprint 0 next week. I will remain on-thread for the first two weeks to support AE -> CS transitions.

Deal snapshot (what matters):
- Contract: Annual committed Dedicated capacity (12x A100-equivalent GPU hours/day) + hosted failover.
- Signed ARR: $1.2M; go-live target: 2028-09-15 (customer wants mid-September).
- Trial/prod split: 30% traffic directed to Redwood Dedicated (primary), 70% to Hosted API until full validation.
- Special terms: 45-day SLA ramp, demo data included, E2E audit window in Q4.

Primary customer contacts (external):
- Ellie Morgan (Head of ML Ops) — ellie.morgan@lumenhealth.com (day-to-day).
- Trevor Shaw (IT/Network) — trevor.shaw@lumenhealth.com (network & procurement).
- Procurement inbox: procurement@lumenhealth.com — expect PO + redlines.

Immediate CS asks / success criteria for Sprint 0 (please convert to checklist in CS tracker):
1) Confirm CS owner & shadowing schedule (Marissa — can you take primary?)
2) Review attached SOW and flag any implementation gaps (SOW_v1 attached)
3) Run network & security checklist with Trevor (attached) — VLAN, egress rules, IP allowlist, proxy settings. He already volunteered network windows July 18–20.
4) Validate infra sizing: Vivek, please confirm Dedicated capacity mapping from sales quote to staging cluster (see attached quote).
5) Set cadence: Weekly internal sync (Mon 10am PT) + biweekly customer touch (Thu 11am PT).
6) Identify any pre-go-live blockers by 2028-08-10 to keep the 9/15 target.

Attachments: [Attachment: Lumen_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)], [Attachment: network_checklist_lumen.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)], [Attachment: redwood_dedicated_quote.pdf (PDF, 64KB)].

Next steps: Marissa — please confirm you own the handoff and propose Sprint 0 acceptance criteria by EOD Friday. Aditya — adding any open commercial/PO items? Ellie/Trevor — welcome any immediate concerns.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 06 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: LumenHealth production onboarding — timeline, owners, and prerequisites

Hi all — happy to take primary CS ownership for LumenHealth. Thanks for the clear context, Priyom. I’ll set up the Sprint 0 checklist in the CS tracker and invite the team to the Mon 10am PT standing.

Quick responses:
- SOW: I’ll review today and call out gaps. If any new deliverables are needed (e.g., extra validation window), I’ll flag with Priyom.
- Network call: Trevor — can you confirm which of the three windows (Jul 18/19/20) is best? We’ll plan to have a brief internal dry-run on Jul 16.
- Cadence: Monday internal sync + Thu customer touch sounds good. I’ll propose a 9/15 go-live runbook outline by 7/20.

Initial risks I see:
- Data residency: Lumen wants logs retained for 2 years; we need to confirm storage and log export options with Security.
- Model pinning: customer expects exact model parity between staging and prod (quantized variant + hosted fallback). We should confirm versioning policy.
- Procurement timeline: if PO delays past 7/25, hardware reservation for Dedicated could be impacted.

Action items I’m taking now:
1) Create CS Sprint 0 checklist and invite the group (due: 7/06 EOD).
2) Review SOW and post comments (due: 7/07 noon PT).
3) Coordinate with Vivek on infra sizing and staging access (Vivek, see comment).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Sales → CS: LumenHealth production onboarding — timeline, owners, and prerequisites

Marissa — great, thanks. Two clarifications from AE side:
- Procurement: Aditya, please confirm expected PO ETA and whether customer will accept our standard T&Cs or if legal redlines are expected.
- Staging data: Ellie confirmed we can use a 200k-record anonymized sample for validation; she’ll share S3 path once network access is in place.

I’m adding a very short commercial summary here for context (won’t be public):
- Discount: 18% off list for first year (applied).
- Credits: 200k inference-token credits included for ramp validation.
- Penalty/credits schedule: SLA credits kick in after 45 days post-go-live per contract.

I’ve uploaded the latest SOW + network checklist and the quote referenced earlier. If you want, I can spin up a 30-minute intro call with Ellie + Trevor tomorrow to walk the SOW before your internal review.

Date: Fri, 07 Jul 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: LumenHealth production onboarding — timeline, owners, and prerequisites

Looping in infra notes on Dedicated capacity and a rough timeline.

Short version: quote maps to 3x medium-sized inference nodes for primary Dedicated pool (estimated throughput ~1.2K tokens/sec sustained for target prompt mix). Staging cluster can be provisioned in our shared staging region within 5 business days after PO + account setup.

Blockers / dependencies from engineering side:
- PO & Billing account: must be active before we reserve GPUs (PO ETA by 7/25 to hit hardware reservation for Sep 15).
- Network allowlist: need static IPs from Trevor to open firewall rules (please send by 7/16).
- Model artifact format: we support the customer's ONNX export, but customer must confirm KV cache & quantization flavor; otherwise we will run our standard q4_0 profile.

Proposed technical milestones: 
- 7/16: internal dry-run (CS + Infra) to validate checklist.
- 7/18–7/20: customer-facing network window with Trevor to verify traffic and S3 access.
- 8/01: staging cluster provisioned and model deployed.
- 8/10–8/24: validation period + perf testing.
- 9/01–9/12: cutover rehearsals and final signoff.

I’ll add these milestones to the runbook Marissa creates. If anyone needs a deeper capacity write-up I can attach the perf profile.

—Vivek
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
